description:
Pandu World 2.0 is an interactive, web-based conversational AI interface developed by Karthikeya Sirigidi. The platform connects to a custom local language model backend via a Flask proxy server, offering real-time response streaming, session history management, an incognito testing mode, and an automated server status console.

Project Name: Pandu World 2.0

Project Type: Web Application / AI Chat Interface

Website Purpose: AI Assistant Console & Testing Interface

Domain Requested: panduai.is-an.ai
